items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: Because that's what Dude wanted. Dude Adams was his manager.

ctx.x: Alright, first let's get to that. When did you leave Baron Wilkins? And how, under what circumstances?

I left Baron Wilkins after being there about a year and two or three months. And what happened -- Old Man Baron didn't want me to leave. But what happened, the dude wanted to cut the band down. Well as I knew in those days and as I feel today, the band was more important than me. See, cause I could have been a good pianist. But I stopped thinking about the piano and started working, now, towards having a good band. See, I thought I'd go farther with a band than I would with a piano. I used to be a composer. I…
